originality.rationale: The 2022 WPL primary source states the PMF, recurrence and qualitative graphical shape changes, not the complete analytic threshold staircase or the resolution limit. A 2024 survey repeats the family without modal thresholds. A 2026 WDLE theorem uses a similar affine-geometric ratio but is for a different parent and parameter map, allowing nonzero modes already at three sectors rather than WPL’s sharp six-sector threshold. Actual semantic record searches found no exact or stronger covering WPL theorem. Independent historical-priority verification remains advisable.

value.rationale: The boundary m=6 is the first resolution at which the fitted model family permits a nonzero fixed-origin modal sector; the exact phase diagram classifies every possible global mode and tie, not only a small numerical slice. These sharp restrictions and the natural unwrapped-limit correction directly explain how angular discretization changes the modal behavior of an applied published circular model. They are not in the model’s cited PMF tables and need no downstream theorem to be useful.
